items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: I saw Mr. Williams once in Zigfield Follies with Will Rogers, see, and we became great friends before he died.

ctx.x: Had you met Williams and Walker up to this point?
No, sir, I never met them at all, see. I saw Mr. Williams once in Zigfield Follies with Will Rogers, see, and we became great friends before he died. Mr. Will
Rogers, he taught me to rope dance, and I still got the mark in my hand now from twirling the rope, you know.
